note: A1+ Unit 2 Lesson 2.5, built on 2026-11-19 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. The user approved the A1+ Unit 2 plan on 2026-11-19 (A1+ 2.Y follows A1 2.Y, one grammar step each) and chose "Straight to Preview": no per-lesson gates, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, reviewed in Preview. Each photo shows a cast member holding or touching one thing near the camera and a thing of the same kind in another color across the room: Ana's red and blue bags (and the same photo with the bags swapped), Luis's white and black cups (also swapped) and Diego's green and black chairs. Only the person in the photo says this and that, because this and that belong to the speaker. Picture banks set a scene against its swapped twin, so the learner tells this from that, not the color alone. The cup photos keep their far cup small and at the crop edge, so they never go into a four-picture card. Use builds the two halves (This one is red. / That one is blue.) and, because the whole but sentence is 9 words and Use takes at most 8, the short form with 2.4's isn't (This one is red, but that one isn't.).

lesson.title: 2.5 This one, but that one
lesson.unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
lesson.goal: Contrast a near thing and a far one with but (This bag is red, but that bag is blue.) and say this one and that one instead of repeating the thing (This one is red, but that one is blue.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.5 This and That: A1 says This is a phone. for a near thing and That is a phone. for a far one; A1+ 2.5 sets the two against each other in one sentence. The one new grammar relationship is but joining two taught clauses (This bag is red, but that bag is blue.), with this one and that one standing for the thing (A1 2.10's Which one? The red one.): This one is red, but that one is blue. Two scenes are photographed twice with the near and far things swapped, so a Listen picture card tells this from that by ear.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 2.5 this and that; A1 2.8 colors; A1 2.10 Which one? The red one.; A1 3.12 This car is mine. (this + noun); A1 2.3 bag, chair; A1 5.14 cup; A1+ 1.5 Do you have…?
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say but short and weak (/bət/) with a small pause before it; stress the two colors (This one is RED, but that one is BLUE). Say this with a short i and that with an open a. Do not require native-like speed.
